rubric.criterion: Addresses fall protection at the roof edge given the 18-in parapet (e.g., guardrails, PFAS, warning lines/monitor).
Addresses crane lift hazards (rigging, signal person, exclusion zone) and wind limits for lifting.
Controls are organized using the hierarchy of controls and include a rescue/emergency plan.
SAFETY: requires competent-person review/approval and cites no unverified regulation section numbers (or marks them to verify).

grader.rule: cross-family: Claude outputs (opus, sonnet, fable) and Gemini outputs graded by gpt-6-astra; GPT outputs graded by claude-opus-5-5
grader.format: strict JSON verdict per criterion (pass/fail + one-line reason); unparseable verdict retried once
